title: Company registration
intro: Minimal registration at installation; complete details inside the ERP. No vendor master account.
manual: Manual entry is available. External lookup is unconfigured and disabled.
uncertain: Uncertain response: query the original attempt; no automatic resend.
fiscalNote: These details do not authorize issuance or prove homologation. Configure certificates and tokens separately.
unsaved: Unsaved data or a pending attempt remains. Leave anyway?
lostKey: Losing the master key makes secrets inaccessible. The ERP vendor cannot recover them. Generate and export your private backup at installation.
dataDestination: Choose the destination in installation configuration: local, own server or customer cloud. Selecting a connection does not migrate data or send keys to the vendor.
